title: US Oil Prices Drop 5% in Sharp Single-Session Decline
detail: US oil prices fell sharply by approximately 5% in a significant single-session decline, marking one of the steeper intraday moves in recent months. The drop raises concerns about weakening demand expectations across global energy markets and may signal broader economic softening. Falling oil prices add to the composite recession risk picture, as sustained declines historically correlate with reduced industrial activity and investment.
